answer: The ferrous schedule is applied in ember and knoll exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3094 identities would post 4317 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
